notes.title: First public appearance of Wonderfall at gamescom!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello curious mind,[/h2][p][/p][p]An ancient world is awakening… and you’re among the first to hear its echoes.
[/p][p]We’re excited to share that [b]Wonderfall[/b] will make its [b]public debut at gamescom 2025[/b]!
It’ll be your very first chance to experience the game hands-on, through an exclusive playable version.[/p][p][/p][p]But this is just a glimpse.
A [b]more complete demo will be available on Steam this fall[/b], during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]Add [b]Wonderfall[/b] to your [b]wishlist[/b] so you don’t miss the moment the gates open.[/p][p][/p][p]Léon is waiting...[/p][p]Stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455827/ee86c3fa2324937dc1648959a138a4e3ae3d9b41.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Wonderfall - Official Game Trailer
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share the first glimpse of [b]Wonderfall[/b] with you. [/p][p]Discover a hauntingly beautiful 1920s Paris slowly consumed by Entropy — a mysterious force turning buildings to sand and dust.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9jTU4h_BCyA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Step into the shoes of Léon, a young orphan with the unique ability to shape the sand itself. Navigate a crumbling city through puzzles, platforming challenges, and contemplative exploration as you unravel the truth behind the city’s collapse.[/p][p][/p][p]Every building holds secrets, and every corner of Paris whispers stories of a world slipping away. [/p][p]Will you uncover the mystery before it’s lost forever?[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned — more adventures await this fall![/p]
